test.create_query: CREATE TABLE zstd_partial_hits ( CounterID UInt32, EventDate Date, UserID UInt64, WatchID UInt64, URL String CODEC(ZSTD(3)), Title String CODEC(ZSTD(3)), Referer String CODEC(ZSTD(3)), OriginalURL String CODEC(ZSTD(3)), SearchPhrase String CODEC(ZSTD(3)) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, UserID, WatchID)
CREATE TABLE zstd_partial_prefix (k UInt64, s String CODEC(ZSTD(3))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO zstd_partial_hits SELECT CounterID, EventDate, UserID, WatchID, URL, Title, Referer, OriginalURL, SearchPhrase FROM hits_100m_single WHERE intHash64(WatchID) % 10 = 0
INSERT INTO zstd_partial_prefix SELECT number, repeat(hex(cityHash64(number)), 6) FROM numbers(20000000)
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(cityHash64(URL, Title)) FROM zstd_partial_hits WHERE UserID % 1000 = 17
SELECT URL, Referer, OriginalURL, Title FROM zstd_partial_hits WHERE Title LIKE '%Google%' AND SearchPhrase != '' FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(cityHash64(Title, URL, Referer, OriginalURL)) FROM zstd_partial_hits SETTINGS max_block_size = 1024
SELECT sum(cityHash64(Title, URL, Referer, OriginalURL)) FROM zstd_partial_hits
SELECT sum(cityHash64(s)) FROM zstd_partial_prefix PREWHERE k % 8192 < 64
